item.title: Fellow Ghanaians: The hospitals we have to be ashamed of - MyJoyOnline
item.description: Fellow Ghanaians, there is a particular kind of cruelty in being sick. You are already vulnerable, already frightened, already at the mercy of a body that has stopped cooperating with you, and all you want, all any human being in that condition wants, is to be taken somewhere safe, somewhere clean, somewhere staffed with people who have the tools and the resources to help you fight your way back. item.title: International relations expert calls for justice and apology for centuries of African suffering - MyJoyOnline
item.description: International relations expert Nana Yaw Mireku has backed calls for the global community to formally recognise the transatlantic slave trade as a grave crime against humanity, emphasising the need for justice, accountability, and a formal apology for centuries of African suffering.

item.title: President Mahama urges leaders to ‘speak truth to power’ ahead of UN slavery resolution vote - MyJoyOnline
item.description: President John Dramani Mahama has called on Member States of the United Nations (UN) to “speak truth to power” and support the passage of a historic UN resolution addressing the legacy of slavery.

item.title: Eating the giants: The climate cost of Techiman’s vanishing “bungalow mountains” - MyJoyOnline
item.description: Before the big machines came. Before the dust filled the rivers. There was a mountain. The people of Techiman called it “Bungalow” because from far away it looked like the roof of a house—green, strong, and giving shade.

item.title: Agric Minister fires back at FABAG over tomato crisis - MyJoyOnline
item.description: The Minister for Food and Agriculture, Eric Opoku, has responded to the ultimatum issued by the Food and Beverages Association of Ghana (FABAG), defending the ministry’s efforts to address the ongoing tomato supply crisis.

item.title: Artemis II crew take 'spectacular' image of Earth - MyJoyOnline
item.description: Nasa has shared the first high-resolution images of the Earth taken by the Artemis II crew as they head on their trip around the Moon.

item.title: Former UGMC boss recounts 'up and down' hospital nightmare resulting in niece's death - MyJoyOnline
item.description: The former Chief Executive Officer of the University of Ghana Medical Centre (UGMC), Dr Darius Osei, has revealed how he watched helplessly as his niece died due to chronic gaps in the country's emergency care system.

item.title: Asiedu Nketia supports AshantiFest 2026 art initiative with GH¢50,000 - MyJoyOnline
item.description: The National Chairman of the National Democratic Congress, Johnson Asiedu Nketia, has donated GH¢50,000 to support a street art initiative under AshantiFest in the Ashanti Region. The donation was made during a ceremony at the Asokwa Interchange, where students and teachers from local schools unveiled a mural as part of efforts to transform selected interchanges into public art spaces.

item.title: Sky-high spectacle as 2026 Kwahu Easter Paragliding Festival takes flight - MyJoyOnline
item.description: The skies over the Kwahu enclave transformed into a vibrant tapestry of colour on Friday as the 2026 Kwahu Easter Paragliding Festival officially commenced with a breathtaking display of aerial artistry.

item.title: Agyarko bolsters NPP chairmanship bid with Henry Quartey and Osei-Owusu as campaign leads - MyJoyOnline
item.description: National Chairman aspirant for the New Patriotic Party (NPP), Boakye Kyeremateng Agyarko, has officially tapped two political heavyweights to spearhead his campaign ahead of the party's upcoming internal elections.

item.title: Free Primary Healthcare: Gov't floods clinics with 24,500 medical tools ahead of April 15 launch - MyJoyOnline
item.description: In a massive logistical undertaking to underpin the upcoming Free Primary Healthcare Programme, the government has announced the imminent distribution of over 24,500 pieces of medical equipment to health facilities across all 16 regions.

item.title: "Pay this, pay that, and the patient dies" – Former UGMC boss demands end to cash-and-carry in emergency care - MyJoyOnline
item.description: The former Chief Executive Officer of the University of Ghana Medical Centre (UGMC), Dr Darius Osei, has criticised the "pay-before-service" culture in Ghana’s emergency wards, labelling the practice of demanding money from trauma victims a death sentence.

item.title: Kenpong intervenes as Afua Asantewaa, husband reconcile after public scrutiny - MyJoyOnline
item.description: Businessman and philanthropist Kennedy Agyapong (Kenpong) has intervened in the marriage of media personality Afua Asantewaa Owusu Aduonum and her husband, Kofi Owusu Aduonum, helping the couple resolve recent challenges and reunite. The couple who have been in the public spotlight in recent weeks, are now back together following mediation efforts led by Mr Agyapong, who is regarded by the family as a mentor and father figure.

item.title: Gomoa Easter Carnival: Samini, Ofori Amponsah and Kwabena Kwabena rock Day 2; Obrafour and Kwaw Kese set for Day 3 showdown - MyJoyOnline
item.description: The Gomoa Ekwamkrom Community Park was transformed into a sea of rhythm and colour on Friday night through to Saturday dawn as Day 2 of the Gomoa Easter Carnival reached a breathtaking climax.

item.title: Iran and US race to find missing American crew member downed in fighter jet - MyJoyOnline
item.description: Iranian and American forces raced each other Saturday to recover a crew member of the first US fighter jet to go down inside Iran since the start of the war.
